primary_keyword.placement: H1, title tag, meta description — once, natural

secondary_keywords.placement: Theme section body, natural mention, links to existing verified page

schema_markup: Service Schema (defining custom engineering capabilities, tools, and provider details)
FAQPage Schema (restricted strictly to questions visible to the user on the frontend)
internal_linking_rules: Use exact-match anchor text when pointing to /services/shopify-theme-development to maximize equity transfer.
Strict no-loop policy: Do not link to an internal page that links back to this page using identical anchor text.

sections.name: Hero
sections.purpose: State what this page is about and give a clear next action. First thing anyone sees.
content_strategy: H1 uses the primary keyword naturally, not stuffed.
One subtitle line only. No paragraph. No stats block unless numbers are already confirmed real.
Two CTAs: WhatsApp and Book a call, matching the rest of the site.
Do not describe the service in detail here — that belongs in the sections below.
Write in 'we' voice, singular-safe (no 'our team', no 'our studio').

sections.name: What is custom Shopify development
sections.purpose: Define the term in plain language using a real example, not a dictionary definition.
content_strategy: Keep the gifting-store engraving example from the working notes — specific example beats abstract definition.
Explain the difference between customizing a theme's colors/fonts and true custom development (building something that doesn't exist in the Shopify App Store or Theme Store).
Short sentences. No AI stock phrases ('unlock', 'seamless', 'robust').
No keyword stuffing — say the primary keyword once here if it fits naturally, don't force it twice.

sections.name: Custom themes vs off-the-shelf
sections.purpose: Explain what a custom-built theme actually changes versus an off-the-shelf Shopify theme.
content_strategy: H2 naturally works in 'custom shopify theme development'.
Mention 'shopify theme development' once, link to /services/shopify-theme-development (existing verified page).
Describe real technical differences: page structure, filtering, image handling, size guides — tied to what the merchant actually sells, not generic 'looks and feels great' language.
Mention Online Store 2.0 drag-and-drop editing as a real, concrete benefit merchants get post-launch — this is a genuine technical fact, not a claim.
No fabricated client examples — describe capability in general terms or reference an actual portfolio project if one demonstrates it.

sections.name: Custom checkout, private apps, and integrations
sections.purpose: Cover the higher-end custom work: checkout customization, private apps, third-party integrations.
content_strategy: H2 naturally works in 'custom shopify app development'.

Checkout customization is described here as a capability only — do not build a dedicated keyword-targeted subsection for it (verified: no commercial-intent search volume exists for any checkout customization phrase).

Use real technical specifics: Liquid, Shopify Admin API, Storefront API, webhooks. This is where technical depth matters most — a prospect evaluating custom work wants to see real capability, not marketing language.

List concrete examples (ERP/inventory sync, custom subscription rules, B2B portals, loyalty programs, automated order workflows) as capabilities offered, not as claimed past results unless a real portfolio project backs a specific one.

If referencing Shopify Plus-specific features (Checkout Extensibility, B2B), only state these as real if the site can back the claim — do not imply access to features Sanchit hasn't actually worked with.

sections.name: Headless Shopify
sections.purpose: Briefly cover headless as an option, with an honest caveat about when it's worth it.
content_strategy: Keep this section short — headless is a secondary/advanced offering, not the page's main focus.
Include an honest tradeoff: headless is a bigger investment and isn't right for every brand. This kind of honest caveat builds trust — keep it.
No unverified performance claims ('blazing fast', 'best in class') — describe what headless actually changes structurally (Shopify as backend, custom frontend framework) instead.
Can link to a dedicated headless service page later if one gets built — don't try to fully cover headless here.

sections.name: Relevant work (proof section)
sections.purpose: Link to real portfolio pages that demonstrate the capabilities described above.
content_strategy: Link to Iron Crate (bundle builder), Industrial Supply Direct (B2B/quote flow), and any other portfolio project relevant to a claim made earlier on this page.
Every capability claim made in the sections above should be traceable to a real portfolio example here where possible — this is how the page avoids sounding like unverified marketing.
Keep descriptions short here — this section points to full case studies, it doesn't repeat them.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.purpose: Answer real buyer questions: cost, timeline, process, freelancer vs agency — for trust and conversion, not for SEO ranking (these phrases mostly have no search volume).
content_strategy: Cost and timeline questions are good to include — matches real buyer intent even without search volume behind the exact phrase.
Never copy a competitor's price ranges. Use real numbers if confirmed, or answer with a qualitative range/process instead of a fabricated number.

If including a freelancer-vs-agency question, answer it honestly from this site's actual position: direct access to the person doing the work, no markup, no account-manager layer. Never conclude 'agency is better' — that directly contradicts this site's positioning.
Write every answer in plain, direct language — no AI filler phrases.
No FAQPage schema entry for any question not actually shown in the visible FAQ content on the page.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.purpose: Close the page with a clear next step.
content_strategy: Short. One line plus the two CTA buttons (WhatsApp, Book a call) — matches the rest of the site.
No new claims or stats introduced here — this section closes the page, it doesn't add new selling points.

explicitly_excluded_sections.name: Why choose us / self-congratulation section
explicitly_excluded_sections.reason: Competitor reference page (eBizTrait) uses unverifiable claim-stacking here ('we carefully consider which shops we take on', 'guaranteed top-notch product'). This violates the no-unverifiable-claims rule. Do not build this section.

explicitly_excluded_sections.name: Dedicated checkout customization section with its own H2/keyword target
explicitly_excluded_sections.reason: Verified: zero commercial-intent search volume exists for any checkout customization keyword variant tested. Cover checkout customization inside the apps/integrations section only, as a capability description, not a targeted section.
